segments.text: And it will help a lot if we can step back
and have a conversation on climate
with that individual human being we're talking to.
And we have the goal of listening to them
and understanding them, understanding what are the deep values
that are leading to the thoughts and opinions they have.
And if we are trying to win an argument, we'll fail.
